notes.title: v1.5 Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello there, everyone! We are thrilled to announce that version 1.5 has been released. This update brings several improvements to the game, such as:

[list]
[*]A new algorithm to calculate goods sale prices in order to make the economic simulation more realistic.
[*]Several performance improvements that allow the game to run faster, more stable and using less memory.
[*]Players now can manually specify a world seed for the procedural generation of the world.
[*]Fixed bug that caused country relationship tooltips to display incorrectly if they had too many items inside.
[*]Fixed bug that caused rival AI companies to steal your captains occassionally.
[*]Fixed bug that caused fullscreen mode to have some input issues on Linux.
[*]Decreased the volume of ambient sounds a bit so they are not too invasive.
[/list]

As usual, all feedback is welcome! Enjoy!

notes.title: WoT updated to version 1.3!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We're happy to announce the new 1.3 update is now live! This update includes the following new features and fixes:

[list]
[*]New Jumbo Size Maps: This is one of the features our players requested the most. And we are always listening! You will be able to continue playing in the 'normal' size maps, but you also will be able to start new games in the new 'jumbo' size maps, that have 125% more surface area than the 'normal' ones. Also, more countries and more cities provide experienced players with a more challenging and vastly improved experience.
[*]Autosave: This was another feature that lots of people asked for, and it's finally here! If you go to the options menu and enable the "autosave" checkbox the game will be automatically saved every three months of game play. Neat, eh?
[*]Performance Improvements: We've also been working hard in some performance improvements to the supply/demand and prices simulation. Now it runs three times faster than it used to! This was crucial in order to keep the simulation running at a decent speed in the new jumbo maps, as they have many more countries and cities that need to be simulated.
[*]User Interface Improvements: The Cities Window now lists all warehouses you own and their current contents. You can also filter cities to only see those that produce a specific resource.
[*]The minimap in the lower left corner is now automatically hidden when you go to the strategic view mode. I mean, why would you want to have two identical maps in sight at the same time? :)
[*]Some other minor UI improvements: Now when you return from battle the camera will automatically focus on your surviving ships (if any!) so you can take appropriate action, like taking your ships to the nearest shipyard to repair them. Also, now when you change the value of an input field in the automatic trading route window, the corresponding checkbox will automatically be checked.
[*]Minor improvements to the AI algorithms so opponents take smarter decisions about contracts and buying / selling goods.
[*]Fixed broken texts when one of your opponents is bankrupt and you go to the strategic view mode.
[*]Fixed bug that caused lightning sound effects to ignore the sound effects volume slider.
[/list]

notes.title: WoT updated to version 1.1!
notes.content:
[b]It's finally here! The new version of WoT is now available and brings a ton of exciting new features![/b]

[h1]Main Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Attack competitors' ships: Now you can attack your competitors to damage their net worth and steal their goods, and you can even give your ships orders to blockade a port. But be careful, doing so will severely damage your company's reputation!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27664871/01bb80c50a51607848878f517c1f0ce78b817547.jpg[/img]

[*]Fleets: Now you can assemble fleets with several ships and then assign orders to all of them and once, even automatic trading routes.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27664871/cdc1f92f04846de07bc5448eb3c7b5f539257c92.jpg[/img]

[*]Upgradeable trade offices: Now you can upgrade your trade offices in order to obtain more accurate prices information.
[*]Warehouses: Now you can purchase warehouses in cities in order to accumulate goods, and even assign them automatic orders to purchase resources.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27664871/60dc0b8c6b855785c56f281dee95b5593c97d132.jpg[/img]

[*]Bribes: Now you can send expensive and luxurious gifts to rulers in order to improve the relationship with them.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27664871/85c5d3ccef8d34c6ca7034462db27c72a49c61ac.jpg[/img]

[*]Random weather changes with five different sky conditions: clear, partly cloudy, mostly cloudy, overcast and rainy.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27664871/b5e9d246ca74f9304317142cb7cfcb5db71e36a4.jpg[/img]

[*]New ship types to purchase: Fluyt, Corvette and Heavy Frigate!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27664871/e426ad089959634d168aabc57f6378d0b8eac2b6.jpg[/img]

[*]New resources to trade: Beer and Tea!
[*]New "Pacifist" and "Pirate" Steam Achievements.
[*]Winds now affect movement in battle.
[*]Added indicator for active contracts in the right part of the screen.
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added gameplay tips to the loading screen.
[*]Added antialiasing when using "normal", "high" or "ultra" quality settings.
[*]Camera movement keys are now customizable.
[*]Made positive country relationship modifiers last longer.
[*]Added notification when the relationship status with a country changes.
[*]Added setting to display newspapers as notifications instead of appearing in the middle of the screen.
[*]Made "Automatic Trading Route" and "Contracts" windows resizable.
[*]Minor improvements to Artificial Intelligence.
[*]Made colony building positions easier to spot.
[*]Increased maximum number of contracts that can be accepted at once from 4 to 6.
[*]Stocks in the stock market can now be purchased in amounts of 50 instead of 100. This is particularly useful when a company's total shares count is 250.
[*]Better cloud rendering (only for the Windows version for the time being).
[*]Added missing thousand separator in buy/sell stock confirmation message window.
[*]Added a "Cancel" button to the "assign captain" and "copy auto trade route" windows.
[*]Added text labels to HP and cargo bars in the Ships Window.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug that sometimes caused "36 Pound Guns" and "Bronze Cannons" upgrades to have zero effect in battle.
[*]Fixed bug that sometimes caused landlocked cities to be generated in the map.
[*]Fixed bug that sometimes caused ships to appear over an obstacle in battle.
[*]Fixed bug that caused the colony window not to display odd and even rows in different colors.
[*]Available contracts are now persisted in the saved game, so you no longer can save and load the game in order to obtain fresh ones.
[*]Available war contracts are now removed if the war that triggered them ended.
[/list]

notes.content:
Hello everyone! We're thrilled to announce a new update for Winds Of Trade.

As we've said before, we are 100% commited to continue improving the game in order to make it easier and more fun to play. Your feedback, ideas and bug reports have been incredibly useful. Thank you so much!

This version has the following improvements and bug fixes:

[list]
[*]New notification sounds for "Contract Failed", "Contract Completed", "Colony Position Discovered", "Ship Repaired" and "Ship Ready" events. Now they no longer play the bell sound, each one of those has a distinctive sound to make it easier to understand what's going on.
[*]Mini "Ship" windows in the bottom part of the screen when multiple ships are selected.
[*]Add price information in the "Auto Trade Route" screen.
[*]Larger font size and better key words highlighting in "Contracts" screen.
[*]Add legend box to "Countries" and "Cities" screens.
[*]Fixed bug that could sometimes cause a saboteur to retry his malicious actions after failing.
[*]Fixed bug that could sometimes cause the "Industries" tab of the "City" screen to have its scrollbar in an invalid position.
[*]Fixed bug that could rarely cause already delivered ships to be displayed in the "Shipyard" tab as being built.
[/list]

The next update will include some more improvements and bug fixes and will also feature a brand new "Battle Tutorial", which will basically be a crash course for new players explaining how the battle system works.

After that, we will be on our way to the next version, which will include some big changes the community has requested, such as the ability to assemble fleets with Automatic Trade Routes, more interesting Trade Offices possibilities and allowing you to attack your competitors' ships.

As we've said before, we are 100% commited to continue improving the game in order to make it easier and more fun to play. Your feedback, ideas and bug reports have been incredibly useful. Thank you so much!

This version has the following improvements and bug fixes:

[list]
[*]New notification sounds for "Contract Failed", "Contract Completed", "Colony Position Discovered", "Ship Repaired" and "Ship Ready" events. Now they no longer play the bell sound, each one of those has a distinctive sound to make it easier to understand what's going on.
[*]Mini "Ship" windows in the bottom part of the screen when multiple ships are selected.
[*]Add price information in the "Auto Trade Route" screen.
[*]Larger font size and better key words highlighting in "Contracts" screen.
[*]Add legend box to "Countries" and "Cities" screens.
[*]Fixed bug that could sometimes cause a saboteur to retry his malicious actions after failing.
[*]Fixed bug that could sometimes cause the "Industries" tab of the "City" screen to have its scrollbar in an invalid position.
[*]Fixed bug that could rarely cause already delivered ships to be displayed in the "Shipyard" tab as being built.
[/list]

The next update will include some more improvements and bug fixes and will also feature a brand new "Battle Tutorial", which will basically be a crash course for new players explaining how the battle system works.

After that, we will be on our way to the next version, which will include some big changes the community has requested, such as the ability to assemble fleets with Automatic Trade Routes, more interesting Trade Offices possibilities and allowing you to attack your competitors' ships.

notes.title: WoT updated to version 0.7.13 and Linux release!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We're really excited to announce Winds Of Trade has received a new update. This includes numerous improvements and bug fixes, and it's also [b]the very first version that is publicly available for SteamOS and Linux systems[/b]. Here's a list of the changes:

[list]
[*]New feature to copy automatic trading routes from one ship to another.
[*]New button to delete old saved games in the main menu.
[*]New "camera speed" setting so the player can customize how fast the camera moves.
[*]The game now automatically is put in pause when an important notification (such as a threat from a smuggler or a recently unlocked feature) is shown.
[*]Added domestic consumption data in the industries window.
[*]Added a tooltip to see the price at which a resource was purchased in the ship's window cargo hold (the one shown in the bottom of the screen when you have a ship selected).
[*]Ships being built are now shown in the Shipyard window.
[*]Ships being repaired now show how many days they have left until the repairs are finished in the Shipyard tab. Before you had to click the "repair" button in order to see that information.
[*]Added new rule to make sure a ship doesn't get two or more "courage" modifiers in a row in battle.
[*]Tweaked pathfinding algorithms so ships do not sail too close to the shore.
[*]Tweaked opium production and consumption rates to make it a bit less profitable.
[*]Some small tweaks to the main menu music and the sound played when one of your ships is sabotaged.
[*]Fixed bug that sometimes caused a Stock Split not to give new shares to the shareholders (e.g. your company owned 400 shares of another company and after the split it would still own 400 instead of 800)
[*]Fixed bug in automatic trading routes that would sometimes cause a Sell Action to sell more than specified if combined with a Buy Action in the same city.
[*]Fixed bug that caused one city name to be missing from the Countries window when a country had 10 or more cities.
[*]Fixed bug that made the scroll bars in the Save Game and Load Game windows not to respond to the mouse scroll wheel.
[*]Fixed bug in automatic trading routes that could sometimes cause a ship to stop executing a route if one of the steps was deleted.
[*]Fixed bug that could cause some long company names to get separated in two lines in the top bar (I'm looking at you, Broken Biscuit Trading Co!)
[*]Fixed bug that caused the UI to be displayed in a very large size if, after playing the game once in a high resolution setting, it's started in a lower resolution.
[*]Fixed exploit in automatic trading routes that allowed you to sell illegal goods in a port.
[/list]

notes.title: Roadmap for future updates
notes.content:
Hello everyone. We have been receiving tons and tons of very useful feedback and taking note of every item in our cargo hold. We should definitely consider getting the "Cargo Hold Optimization" upgrade!

Here's the roadmap for future updates:

First we are going to focus on delivering two more patches that will include several bug fixes, user experience and gameplay improvements. These two will probably be delivered next week. Also, we are going to release the game for SteamOS/Linux very soon.

After we get all of those done the road for the next major version of the game begins. We plan to work hard on some very exciting features for the next release, which will take a few weeks to reach Steam. Some of the main features in the next major update will be:

[list]
[*]New "Trade Office" tab in the city window, where you can upgrade your trade office for more accurate prices and product quantities reporting. You will also be able to purchase or rent warehouses in cities.
[*]You will be able to attack competitors' ships, which really comes in handy in the Conquest game mode.
[*]You will be able to create 'fleets' and assign them automatic trading routes, so the ships in them execute your orders as one unit, always sticking together in order to be safe from pirates and other threats.
[*]Several new resources to trade, such as spices, tea and beer.
[/list]

Thank you all for your amazing feedback and constructive criticism!

notes.title: WoT updated to version 0.7.12
notes.content:
As we said before, at Hermes Interactive we are absolutely commited to improving the game with the suggestions we get from all of you. This new update includes:

[list]
[*]Automatic Trading Routes now keep track of profit and losses since you started them.
[*]Tweaked the placement of production buildings in the world so it's more unlikely that a city will produce the same goods it needs (for example, having both an arsenal and barracks in the same city).
[*]New legend box in the city window that explains the meaning of the different colors of prices.
[*]Price tooltips in the city window now appear much faster than before.
[*]When trying to buy or sell goods in a city with no trade office after you open one it will automatically resume whatever action you were going to do.
[*]More accurate data in the competitors window charts, particularly in the 1, 3 and 5 years zoom levels.
[*]Several improvements to the soundtrack of the game, made by our wonderful composer!
[*]Cities where you own a trade office are now marked with an asterisk in the Automatic Trading Route window.
[*]Fixed an exploit that allowed the player to improve the relationship with a country by buying and selling the same goods many times.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the UI to lag severely when creating an Automatic Trading Route with over 15 steps.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the AI players to glitch if you sabotaged one of their ships.
[/list]

Now onwards to the next update! And also the SteamOS / Linux release that is coming in a few days. 

As always, thanks for your feedback!

notes.title: A tutorial is on its way!
notes.content:
When we first developed Winds Of Trade we didn't think about adding a Tutorial as most other games do. We thought experimentation and discovery of how everything works would be part of the fun for most players. But we were wrong. The result was a frustrating experience for some of the new players.

So, we have decided to make things right and add a Basic Tutorial to the game. The update including this and a few other improvements should hit Steam in just a couple of days. So, stay tuned!

And once again, thank you everyone for your feedback!

notes.title: WoT updated to version 0.7.10.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone. We're thrilled to announce the very first update for the game. We've been taking a close look at all of your useful feedback and decided to make a few fixes to make the game more enjoyable. Here are the details for this first update:

[list]
[*]You can now sort the info in the prices window however you want (by city name, by price, by quantity, by how old the last update is...)
[*]Cities with shipyards are now clearly marked in the strategic view (the one you get with the M key or by zooming out a lot)
[*]Saved games now indicate the date and time when they were last saved.
[*]You can now move around the map by dragging the pointer to the edge of the screen instead of with the W-A-S-D keys only.
[*]Smuggling has been made a bit easier in the 'easy' and 'normal' game modes.
[*]The probability of a bribe failing has been increased, especially in the 'hard' and 'impossible' game modes.
[*]The frequency and strength of pirate attacks has been reduced, especially in the 'easy' game mode.
[/list]

Thank you all for your feedback and for helping us make our game even better. More to come! :)

notes.title: Next Steps After Release
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The game has been live for six hours now and we are listening to all of your valuable feedback. In the next few days a patch will be released that addresses some of your concerns. Keep the great ideas and suggestions coming, and thank you for being so participative!

Some of the things to expect for the first update to the game (should be out before this week ends):

- Indicators to know which cities have a shipyard.
- Add a legend box to the strategic map.
- Show creation date and time in saved games.
- Allow players to sort goods by their price in both the city and the prices window.
- A master volume slider in the settings window.

After that we'll start working on adding a basic tutorial so the learning curve becomes a bit shallower.
